family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

advantageously.oewn-00014255-r.label: positive
advantageously.oewn-00014255-r.tone: The adverb of *advantageous*: cool, calculating approval — it rates a thing by the edge it hands you and says nothing about whether that edge is deserved or does any good.

affably.oewn-00221532-r.label: positive
affably.oewn-00221532-r.tone: The adverb of *affable*: easy, unforced warmth of manner - friendliness that costs its owner nothing.

family.axis: flat registration that one knows something → keen, quickened responsiveness of mind

alertly.oewn-00271723-r.label: positive
alertly.oewn-00271723-r.tone: The adverb of *alert*: praises the mind as quick on its feet - perception poised to respond, not merely present as in *aware*.

amiably.oewn-00221532-r.label: positive
amiably.oewn-00221532-r.tone: The adverb of *amiable*: mild, slightly old-fashioned praise; pleasantness rather than depth.

angrily.oewn-00228939-r.label: negative
angrily.oewn-00228939-r.tone: The adverb of *angry*: reports the feeling without judging it; the mildest and least loaded word in the family.

appreciatively.oewn-00272695-r.label: positive
appreciatively.oewn-00272695-r.tone: The adverb of *appreciative*: cooler and more measured; it values the thing rather than feeling the debt.

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

approximately.oewn-00007414-r.label: neutral
approximately.oewn-00007414-r.tone: The adverb of *approximate*: measuring and cool - it rates a resemblance as very close while stopping short of calling it the same thing.

arrogantly.oewn-00267447-r.label: negative
arrogantly.oewn-00267447-r.tone: The adverb of *arrogant*: condemns self-importance as unearned - the confidence is real, the entitlement is not.

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

assuredly.oewn-00268242-r.label: positive
assuredly.oewn-00268242-r.tone: The adverb of *assured*: shifts from the inner state to the visible one, crediting a confidence you can see in the bearing where *confident* merely records it.

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

baldly.oewn-00278639-r.label: negative
baldly.oewn-00278639-r.tone: The adverb of *bald*: blunt - concealment is not just absent but conspicuously unattempted, and the missing softening reads as harshness.

barbarously.oewn-00279287-r.label: negative
barbarously.oewn-00279287-r.tone: The adverb of *barbarous*: condemns as a whole civilisation would: this is beneath what people owe each other.

beautifully.oewn-00243465-r.label: positive
beautifully.oewn-00243465-r.tone: The adverb of *beautiful*: the full word - unreserved and applicable to anything from a face to an argument.

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

beneficially.oewn-00279796-r.label: positive
beneficially.oewn-00279796-r.tone: The adverb of *beneficial*: formal and firmly approving — it credits the thing with actually improving matters, where *advantageous* only counts the edge gained.

benevolently.oewn-00396497-r.label: positive
benevolently.oewn-00396497-r.tone: The adverb of *benevolent*: formal and settled - kindness as a disposition rather than a mood.

bestially.oewn-00281857-r.label: negative
bestially.oewn-00281857-r.tone: The adverb of *bestial*: denies the person's humanity outright.

blithely.oewn-00050835-r.label: positive
blithely.oewn-00050835-r.tone: The adverb of *blithe*: sunny and unburdened - a lightness of spirit meant kindly.

boastfully.oewn-00227289-r.label: negative
boastfully.oewn-00227289-r.tone: The adverb of *boastful*: faults the telling rather than the feeling - pride said out loud too often.

bonnily.oewn-00501131-r.label: positive
bonnily.oewn-00501131-r.tone: The adverb of *bonny*: Scottish and northern English warmth - healthy and pleasing.

boorishly.oewn-00281193-r.label: negative
boorishly.oewn-00281193-r.tone: The adverb of *boorish*: ill-manners as a settled character, and contemptible with it.

bounteously.oewn-00281297-r.label: positive
bounteously.oewn-00281297-r.tone: The adverb of *bounteous*: Biblical in flavour - generosity on a grand scale.

bravely.oewn-00174412-r.label: positive
bravely.oewn-00174412-r.tone: The adverb of *brave*: the plain, universal praise - facing what frightens you.

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

broad-mindedly.oewn-00408778-r.label: positive
broad-mindedly.oewn-00408778-r.tone: The adverb of *broad-minded*: warm, unhedged praise for a settled disposition, crediting respect for the differing view rather than the bare patience *tolerant* stops at.

brutally.oewn-00202624-r.label: negative
brutally.oewn-00202624-r.tone: The adverb of *brutal*: plain and physical, and the least ornamented of the strong words.

brutishly.oewn-00281857-r.label: negative
brutishly.oewn-00281857-r.tone: The adverb of *brutish*: coarse rather than violent: it says unrefined more than it says cruel.

buoyantly.oewn-00282160-r.label: positive
buoyantly.oewn-00282160-r.tone: The adverb of *buoyant*: cheer that resists being pushed down; the metaphor is a thing that will not sink.

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

categorically.oewn-00087676-r.label: neutral
categorically.oewn-00087676-r.tone: The adverb of *categorical*: the unclipped form of *categoric*, and the extra syllable lands as extra weight: reservations are not merely absent but refused.

cavalierly.oewn-00284129-r.label: negative
cavalierly.oewn-00284129-r.tone: The adverb of *cavalier*: disregard worn lightly, as though the other person's stake were not real.

charmingly.oewn-00238490-r.label: positive
charmingly.oewn-00238490-r.tone: The adverb of *charming*: warm and disarming - the pleasure sounds like an appeal exerted on you, gentler than *delightful*'s enthusiasm.

cheerily.oewn-00220805-r.label: positive
cheerily.oewn-00220805-r.tone: The adverb of *cheery*: outward-facing: a cheery greeting is aimed at somebody.

chintzily.oewn-00468873-r.label: negative
chintzily.oewn-00468873-r.tone: The adverb of *chintzy*: stinginess with the embarrassment built in - the cheapness shows.

chirpily.oewn-00282160-r.label: positive
chirpily.oewn-00282160-r.tone: The adverb of *chirpy*: British and small-scale, and grating if the hearer is not cheerful too.

family.axis: plainly perceptible → edge cut to a razor's precision

clearly.oewn-00183387-r.label: neutral
clearly.oewn-00183387-r.tone: The adverb of *clear*: the most unmarked term here for being easy to perceive, carrying no metaphor of cutting at all.

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

closely.oewn-00161858-r.label: neutral
closely.oewn-00161858-r.tone: The adverb of *close*: the plain measure of nearness in relevance or relationship, stating the proximity without the warmth or the suspicion the rest of the set add.

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

coherently.oewn-00287686-r.label: positive
coherently.oewn-00287686-r.tone: The adverb of *coherent*: praise at its lowest setting: the thought holds together and comes out clear, a floor cleared rather than the brightness *lucid* claims.

cold-bloodedly.oewn-00344222-r.label: negative
cold-bloodedly.oewn-00344222-r.tone: The adverb of *cold-blooded*: premeditation is the whole charge - the harm was planned while calm.

complacently.oewn-00289255-r.label: negative
complacently.oewn-00289255-r.tone: The adverb of *complacent*: contentment that should have been alarm - the danger was there to be seen.

conceitedly.oewn-00290736-r.label: negative
conceitedly.oewn-00290736-r.tone: The adverb of *conceited*: faults an inflated opinion of one's own qualities.

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

confidently.oewn-00214025-r.label: neutral
confidently.oewn-00214025-r.tone: The adverb of *confident*: the plain baseline of the family, reporting that the assurance is there without passing any verdict on whether it is warranted.

family.axis: plain attentiveness → exhaustive minute care that tips into excess

conscientiously.oewn-00180072-r.label: positive
conscientiously.oewn-00180072-r.tone: The adverb of *conscientious*: locates the care in the doer's sense of duty rather than in the finished work.

family.axis: flat naming of dullness → slangy contempt for rigid, predictable sameness

conservatively.oewn-00293817-r.label: negative
conservatively.oewn-00293817-r.tone: The adverb of *conservative*: so understated it can pass for plain description, framing the dullness as caution and letting the sting arrive quietly.

contentedly.oewn-00239896-r.label: positive
contentedly.oewn-00239896-r.tone: The adverb of *contented*: settled rather than delighted; it describes a steady state, not a mood.

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

cosily.oewn-00188632-r.label: negative
cosily.oewn-00188632-r.tone: The adverb of *cosy*: the British spelling carrying the same imputation of connivance, warmth named in order to be distrusted.

courageously.oewn-00174412-r.label: positive
courageously.oewn-00174412-r.tone: The adverb of *courageous*: weightier than 'brave' - implies moral choice, not just nerve.

courteously.oewn-00219959-r.label: positive
courteously.oewn-00219959-r.tone: The adverb of *courteous*: formal warmth, with a whiff of chivalry - it praises the manner as a kind of respect.

craftily.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
craftily.oewn-00295240-r.tone: The adverb of *crafty*: homely and old, and the craft is entirely in the deceiving.

creakily.oewn-00304748-r.label: negative
creakily.oewn-00304748-r.tone: The adverb of *creaky*: a rasp or grate that suggests age and strain - the sound of something barely holding.

family.axis: plainly perceptible → edge cut to a razor's precision

crisply.oewn-00212949-r.label: positive
crisply.oewn-00212949-r.tone: The adverb of *crisp*: makes definition feel brisk and pleasurable, a freshness *sharp* does not supply.

crucially.oewn-00294248-r.label: positive
crucially.oewn-00294248-r.tone: The adverb of *crucial*: importance at its sharpest - something turns on this, and the turning is what the word insists on.

cruelly.oewn-00234230-r.label: negative
cruelly.oewn-00234230-r.tone: The adverb of *cruel*: the central moral charge: the suffering was known about and inflicted anyway.

cunningly.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
cunningly.oewn-00295240-r.tone: The adverb of *cunning*: skill in deceiving, and the skill is half admired - the disapproval is real but not total.

curiously.oewn-00082231-r.label: positive
curiously.oewn-00082231-r.tone: The adverb of *curious*: approving of the mind and faintly wary of the manner - the gloss admits both.

cursorily.oewn-00292249-r.label: negative
cursorily.oewn-00292249-r.tone: The adverb of *cursory*: formal and cool - it reports the shallowness without raising its voice.

cynically.oewn-00291936-r.label: negative
cynically.oewn-00291936-r.tone: The adverb of *cynical*: assumes the worst motive as a general rule, which saves the trouble of looking.

dandily.oewn-00505761-r.label: positive
dandily.oewn-00505761-r.tone: The adverb of *dandy*: old-fashioned cheer - approval with a quaint, breezy ring.

deceitfully.oewn-00315990-r.label: negative
deceitfully.oewn-00315990-r.tone: The adverb of *deceitful*: puts the intent in view: not merely wrong, but meaning to mislead.

delightfully.oewn-00300702-r.label: positive
delightfully.oewn-00300702-r.tone: The adverb of *delightful*: enthusiastic - the pleasure is raised to a high pitch and given an edge of entertainment that *pleasing* lacks.

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

demandingly.oewn-00504539-r.label: neutral
demandingly.oewn-00504539-r.tone: The adverb of *demanding*: plain and unheated - it names the size of what is asked without ruling on whether asking it is fair, where *hard-to-please* has already convicted someone.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

demonstrably.oewn-00309952-r.label: neutral
demonstrably.oewn-00309952-r.tone: The adverb of *demonstrable*: shifts from what is seen to what can be shown: the clarity is available on demand rather than immediate, unlike *obvious*.

dependably.oewn-00225012-r.label: positive
dependably.oewn-00225012-r.tone: The adverb of *dependable*: warmer than *reliable*: it suggests someone is doing the depending.

deplorably.oewn-00093820-r.label: negative
deplorably.oewn-00093820-r.tone: The adverb of *deplorable*: formal sorrow at a state of things - lamented rather than blamed.

dictatorially.oewn-00312823-r.label: negative
dictatorially.oewn-00312823-r.tone: The adverb of *dictatorial*: borrows a form of government to describe a manner; the comparison is the insult.

family.axis: plainly perceptible → edge cut to a razor's precision

distinctly.oewn-00183387-r.label: neutral
distinctly.oewn-00183387-r.tone: The adverb of *distinct*: the plain baseline of the family: something registers separately, with no claim about how fine or admirable its edge is.

family.axis: plainly perceptible → edge cut to a razor's precision

distrustfully.oewn-00321801-r.label: negative
distrustfully.oewn-00321801-r.tone: The adverb of *distrustful*: states the position without explaining it - the trust is simply absent.

doggedly.oewn-00237428-r.label: positive
doggedly.oewn-00237428-r.tone: The adverb of *dogged*: the same refusal to yield, entirely admired - dogged is what stubborn is called when it wins.

domineeringly.oewn-00323100-r.label: negative
domineeringly.oewn-00323100-r.tone: The adverb of *domineering*: a habit of overriding others, described from the outside.

dreadfully.oewn-00317880-r.label: negative
dreadfully.oewn-00317880-r.tone: The adverb of *dreadful*: emphatic disapproval with a formal, slightly literary edge.

eagerly.oewn-00202206-r.label: positive
eagerly.oewn-00202206-r.tone: The adverb of *eager*: warm and forward-looking; the desire is presented as a credit to the person.

egotistically.oewn-00328482-r.label: negative
egotistically.oewn-00328482-r.tone: The adverb of *egotistical*: flat contempt for self-importance - the inflation is visible to everyone but its owner.

elegantly.oewn-00328994-r.label: positive
elegantly.oewn-00328994-r.tone: The adverb of *elegant*: restraint doing the work - the highest praise in the family, and the quietest.

enviably.oewn-00004306-r.label: positive
enviably.oewn-00004306-r.tone: The adverb of *enviable*: praises a thing by pointing at the sourness it stirs in whoever lacks it, so the approval arrives through someone else's discontent.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

evidently.oewn-00039730-r.label: neutral
evidently.oewn-00039730-r.tone: The adverb of *evident*: plain and unemphatic: the thing is simply there to be seen, with none of the display *manifest* makes of it.

excellently.oewn-00183802-r.label: positive
excellently.oewn-00183802-r.tone: The adverb of *excellent*: unqualified praise - at the top of its class.

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

expensively.oewn-00335764-r.label: neutral
expensively.oewn-00335764-r.tone: The adverb of *expensive*: the plain word for a high price, stating the fact without deciding whether the price is deserved.

family.axis: merely put into words → spelled out to the last unsoftened detail

explicitly.oewn-00369214-r.label: neutral
explicitly.oewn-00369214-r.tone: The adverb of *explicit*: the neutral benchmark of the family - it claims clarity so complete that nothing is left for the hearer to infer, without praising or faulting that clarity.

family.axis: merely put into words → spelled out to the last unsoftened detail

expressly.oewn-00085862-r.label: neutral
expressly.oewn-00085862-r.tone: The adverb of *express*: formal and pointed, marking a thing as spelled out precisely by contrast with what was left tacit.

fabulously.oewn-00032576-r.label: positive
fabulously.oewn-00032576-r.tone: The adverb of *fabulous*: extravagant - praise pitched at the ceiling and past plausibility, far louder than *pleasing*.

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

fairly.oewn-00107446-r.label: positive
fairly.oewn-00107446-r.tone: The adverb of *fair*: plain, unarguable approval - it certifies that no favoritism or deception got in, without the weight of principle *just* carries.

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

familiarly.oewn-00338291-r.label: positive
familiarly.oewn-00338291-r.tone: The adverb of *familiar*: closeness worn as ease - an established friendship that needs no ceremony, less ardent than *intimate*.

fatuously.oewn-00203322-r.label: negative
fatuously.oewn-00203322-r.tone: The adverb of *fatuous*: silliness with self-satisfaction attached.

faultily.oewn-00340016-r.label: negative
faultily.oewn-00340016-r.tone: The adverb of *faulty*: puts the error in the thing itself, as a defect it carries rather than a slip it made.

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

favourably.oewn-00232060-r.label: positive
favourably.oewn-00232060-r.tone: The adverb of *favourable*: the British spelling of *favorable*, carrying the identical tilt-in-your-favour approval with no shift in force.

firstly.oewn-00103286-r.label: positive
firstly.oewn-00103286-r.tone: The adverb of *first*: rank asserted flatly; it orders things and leaves the reason unsaid.

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

flatly.oewn-00087676-r.label: neutral
flatly.oewn-00087676-r.tone: The adverb of *flat*: blunt and monosyllabic — the refusal of reservations delivered as a door shutting, where *categorical* delivers it as a pronouncement.

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

fortuitously.oewn-00042664-r.label: positive
fortuitously.oewn-00042664-r.tone: The adverb of *fortuitous*: insists on the chance: the good outcome arrived unsteered.

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

fortunately.oewn-00042664-r.label: positive
fortunately.oewn-00042664-r.tone: The adverb of *fortunate*: approval with the surprise kept in - the good turn was neither earned nor expected.

foxily.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
foxily.oewn-00295240-r.tone: The adverb of *foxy*: the animal metaphor - deceit with the fox's reputation for it.

fraudulently.oewn-00346945-r.label: negative
fraudulently.oewn-00346945-r.tone: The adverb of *fraudulent*: the legal word: it implies a crime has been committed, not merely a lie told.

gamely.oewn-00348618-r.label: positive
gamely.oewn-00348618-r.tone: The adverb of *game*: willing to try - courage as good sportsmanship rather than heroism.

generously.oewn-00198104-r.label: positive
generously.oewn-00198104-r.tone: The adverb of *generous*: the plain, unqualified praise - it credits both the giving and the spirit behind it.

genially.oewn-00221532-r.label: positive
genially.oewn-00221532-r.tone: The adverb of *genial*: warmth that puts a room at ease.

genteelly.oewn-00349398-r.label: positive
genteelly.oewn-00349398-r.tone: The adverb of *genteel*: refinement praised, but primly - the word can carry a faintly pitying edge, as in 'shabby-genteel'.

genuinely.oewn-00270584-r.label: positive
genuinely.oewn-00270584-r.tone: The adverb of *genuine*: warm without being showy: it says a thing is what it claims, and that this was worth saying.

gluttonously.oewn-00351651-r.label: negative
gluttonously.oewn-00351651-r.tone: The adverb of *gluttonous*: names one of the seven deadly sins; the excess is a moral failure, not an appetite.

gorgeously.oewn-00351959-r.label: positive
gorgeously.oewn-00351959-r.tone: The adverb of *gorgeous*: dazzling and enthusiastic - beauty that stops you.

gratefully.oewn-00272695-r.label: positive
gratefully.oewn-00272695-r.tone: The adverb of *grateful*: the plain word for the feeling, with no reservation in it.

family.axis: weighty enough to demand attention → threatening great harm with hope nearly gone

grievously.oewn-00353034-r.label: negative
grievously.oewn-00353034-r.tone: The adverb of *grievous*: the most formal and heavily weighted of these, sounding the wound itself as much as the threat of it.

grotesquely.oewn-00353338-r.label: negative
grotesquely.oewn-00353338-r.tone: The adverb of *grotesque*: distorted to the point of unsettling - beyond plain ugliness.

grubbily.oewn-00502424-r.label: negative
grubbily.oewn-00502424-r.tone: The adverb of *grubby*: mild enough to be affectionate - dirt of the kind a child comes home in.

grungily.oewn-00502424-r.label: negative
grungily.oewn-00502424-r.tone: The adverb of *grungy*: informal and unimpressed - dirt that has been let settle in for good.

handsomely.oewn-00354848-r.label: positive
handsomely.oewn-00354848-r.tone: The adverb of *handsome*: praises strong, well-proportioned looks; dignity rather than prettiness.

hatefully.oewn-00356040-r.label: negative
hatefully.oewn-00356040-r.tone: The adverb of *hateful*: makes ill will the whole of the charge, naming the malice itself where *nasty* only shades toward it.

haughtily.oewn-00176109-r.label: negative
haughtily.oewn-00176109-r.tone: The adverb of *haughty*: cold, distant superiority - looking down from a height.

family.axis: bare defensibility → judgment praised as solid, steady and clear-minded

healthily.oewn-00184008-r.label: positive
healthily.oewn-00184008-r.tone: The adverb of *healthy*: casts good judgment as wholesome and robust - a constitution of mind rather than a verdict on one conclusion, warmer and vaguer than *sound*.

hideously.oewn-00358561-r.label: negative
hideously.oewn-00358561-r.tone: The adverb of *hideous*: extreme and repellent - among the harshest words available.

high-handedly.oewn-00359172-r.label: negative
high-handedly.oewn-00359172-r.tone: The adverb of *high-handed*: a decision taken over someone's head, with no thought of asking.

inaccurately.oewn-00206071-r.label: negative
inaccurately.oewn-00206071-r.tone: The adverb of *inaccurate*: measured and impersonal - it faults the result without accusing anyone of carelessness.

inanely.oewn-00203322-r.label: negative
inanely.oewn-00203322-r.tone: The adverb of *inane*: empty of sense - condemns the content, not the person.

indolently.oewn-00374926-r.label: negative
indolently.oewn-00374926-r.tone: The adverb of *indolent*: the softest of the real accusations - it sounds almost like a temperament.

inhumanely.oewn-00361234-r.label: negative
inhumanely.oewn-00361234-r.tone: The adverb of *inhumane*: condemnation in an official voice - cruelty assessed rather than felt.

innocently.oewn-00377640-r.label: positive
innocently.oewn-00377640-r.tone: The adverb of *innocent*: praise with a shadow: the same word can mean unspoiled or unprepared.

inquisitively.oewn-00082231-r.label: positive
inquisitively.oewn-00082231-r.tone: The adverb of *inquisitive*: praise for a child, and a hint of too many questions for an adult.

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

intellectually.oewn-00190641-r.label: neutral
intellectually.oewn-00190641-r.tone: The adverb of *intellectual*: the plain term of the family - it names the faculty being engaged and passes no verdict on it.

intelligently.oewn-00203457-r.label: positive
intelligently.oewn-00203457-r.tone: The adverb of *intelligent*: the neutral, respectable word - approving without flourish.

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

internationally.oewn-00113022-r.label: neutral
internationally.oewn-00113022-r.tone: The adverb of *international*: neutral and minimal in its demand — two nations are enough to satisfy it, where *global* asks for the whole earth.

kindly.oewn-00004775-r.label: positive
kindly.oewn-00004775-r.tone: The adverb of *kind*: the plain, unshowy word, and the one people most want said about them.

knavishly.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
knavishly.oewn-00295240-r.tone: The adverb of *knavish*: names the person a knave - archaic, with a costume-drama ring.

lackadaisically.oewn-00387445-r.label: negative
lackadaisically.oewn-00387445-r.tone: The adverb of *lackadaisical*: comic rather than damning; the failing is a lack of spirit, not of will.

lifelessly.oewn-00391087-r.label: negative
lifelessly.oewn-00391087-r.tone: The adverb of *lifeless*: clinical and detached: it names the absence of life rather than mourning it.

light-heartedly.oewn-00393047-r.label: positive
light-heartedly.oewn-00393047-r.tone: The adverb of *light-hearted*: the hyphenated spelling, identical in warmth.

loyally.oewn-00317497-r.label: positive
loyally.oewn-00317497-r.tone: The adverb of *loyal*: the plain word and the strongest, because it needs no institution to make sense.

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

lucidly.oewn-00391499-r.label: positive
lucidly.oewn-00391499-r.tone: The adverb of *lucid*: the warmest of the three: the same clear consistent thinking praised as brightness, where *coherent* merely reports that it hangs together.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

manifestly.oewn-00039730-r.label: neutral
manifestly.oewn-00039730-r.tone: The adverb of *manifest*: formal and expansive — the thing does not merely show but puts itself on show, a grander word than *evident* for the same clarity.

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

mentally.oewn-00230340-r.label: neutral
mentally.oewn-00230340-r.tone: The adverb of *mental*: the plainest of these, taking in any process the mind performs without the technical precision *psychological* carries.

mercilessly.oewn-00402381-r.label: negative
mercilessly.oewn-00402381-r.tone: The adverb of *merciless*: mercy was available and was withheld; that is the entire charge.

family.axis: bare exactness → exactness pushed past its use

meticulously.oewn-00195747-r.label: positive
meticulously.oewn-00195747-r.tone: The adverb of *meticulous*: warm praise for care taken over every detail, crediting the attention rather than the rulebook.

mincingly.oewn-00404188-r.label: negative
mincingly.oewn-00404188-r.tone: The adverb of *mincing*: mocks refinement as performance - the daintiness is put on.

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

miserably.oewn-00404848-r.label: negative
miserably.oewn-00404848-r.tone: The adverb of *miserable*: gathers the discomfort into a whole bodily condition instead of a single sensation, so it reads as total rather than local.

misleadingly.oewn-00082498-r.label: negative
misleadingly.oewn-00082498-r.tone: The adverb of *misleading*: stops short of accusation: it reports the effect, and leaves the intent unstated.

mistrustfully.oewn-00321801-r.label: negative
mistrustfully.oewn-00321801-r.tone: The adverb of *mistrustful*: the plainer twin of *distrustful*, and a shade more tentative.

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

morally.oewn-00135013-r.label: neutral
morally.oewn-00135013-r.tone: The adverb of *moral*: names not the mind itself but the kind of effect that lands there, real in force with nothing tangible behind it.

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

mortally.oewn-00405983-r.label: negative
mortally.oewn-00405983-r.tone: The adverb of *mortal*: *A mortal enemy* - deadly rather than pitiless, and archaic in flavour.

naively.oewn-00408067-r.label: negative
naively.oewn-00408067-r.tone: The adverb of *naive*: the everyday word, and gentler than it looks - it blames inexperience, not intellect.

nastily.oewn-00408963-r.label: negative
nastily.oewn-00408963-r.tone: The adverb of *nasty*: condemns without naming the fault, covering plain offensiveness and shading into outright ill will, where *hateful* puts the malice at the centre.

naughtily.oewn-00017140-r.label: negative
naughtily.oewn-00017140-r.tone: The adverb of *naughty*: affectionate scolding - too light to carry a real fault.

noisily.oewn-00230871-r.label: negative
noisily.oewn-00230871-r.tone: The adverb of *noisy*: the plain complaint - it names the sound as unwelcome, without heat.

obtusely.oewn-00324708-r.label: negative
obtusely.oewn-00324708-r.tone: The adverb of *obtuse*: formal reproach - slow to understand, and perhaps unwilling to.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

obviously.oewn-00039730-r.label: neutral
obviously.oewn-00039730-r.tone: The adverb of *obvious*: the flat baseline of the group: a thing takes no effort to see or grasp, without *palpable*'s pressure or *axiomatic*'s claim about proof.

optimally.oewn-00416070-r.label: positive
optimally.oewn-00416070-r.tone: The adverb of *optimal*: the same bounded best, worn as an adjective of analysis rather than of praise.

overbearingly.oewn-00417692-r.label: negative
overbearingly.oewn-00417692-r.tone: The adverb of *overbearing*: the weight metaphor is exact - the other person is pressed down, not persuaded.

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

overtly.oewn-00078824-r.label: neutral
overtly.oewn-00078824-r.tone: The adverb of *overt*: flat and formal - it marks a thing as out where it can be seen and stops there, with none of the affront *barefaced* adds.

owlishly.oewn-00418207-r.label: positive
owlishly.oewn-00418207-r.tone: The adverb of *owlish*: appearance only. The owl looks wise; that is the whole of its claim.

family.axis: plain attentiveness → exhaustive minute care that tips into excess

painstakingly.oewn-00418463-r.label: positive
painstakingly.oewn-00418463-r.tone: The adverb of *painstaking*: puts the labour on show - the pains taken are the point, where *conscientious* keeps them inward.

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

passably.oewn-00036138-r.label: neutral
passably.oewn-00036138-r.tone: The adverb of *passable*: acceptance with the bar still visible underneath it: the thing gets through, where *adequate* says it measures up.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

patently.oewn-00039730-r.label: neutral
patently.oewn-00039730-r.tone: The adverb of *patent*: formal and declarative: the clarity is stated as settled fact rather than offered as an impression, where *palpable* appeals to the senses.

patiently.oewn-00175130-r.label: positive
patiently.oewn-00175130-r.tone: The adverb of *patient*: endurance with an even temper - the temper is what distinguishes it from mere waiting.

perfunctorily.oewn-00261760-r.label: negative
perfunctorily.oewn-00261760-r.tone: The adverb of *perfunctory*: the work was done to be seen to be done; it accuses the motive, not the skill.

perkily.oewn-00422171-r.label: positive
perkily.oewn-00422171-r.tone: The adverb of *perky*: brisk and a little relentless - it can condescend when said of an adult.

perseveringly.oewn-00273866-r.label: positive
perseveringly.oewn-00273866-r.tone: The adverb of *persevering*: the same steadiness against resistance; it presumes there was reason to stop.

piggishly.oewn-00424530-r.label: negative
piggishly.oewn-00424530-r.tone: The adverb of *piggish*: greed and coarseness laid on with the farm animal - the comparison does the insulting.

pitilessly.oewn-00402381-r.label: negative
pitilessly.oewn-00402381-r.tone: The adverb of *pitiless*: final and total - it fits weather and landscape as well as people, and is just as cold either way.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

plainly.oewn-00039730-r.label: neutral
plainly.oewn-00039730-r.tone: The adverb of *plain*: the homeliest word here — clarity with no ceremony at all, exactly what *manifest* supplies in excess.

pleasingly.oewn-00427673-r.label: positive
pleasingly.oewn-00427673-r.tone: The adverb of *pleasing*: plain, unraised approval - it states the pleasure and satisfaction given and leaves it there, where *delightful* insists.

politely.oewn-00219959-r.label: positive
politely.oewn-00219959-r.tone: The adverb of *polite*: praise for meeting the standard; it says nothing about warmth, and sometimes implies its absence.

family.axis: bare exactness → exactness pushed past its use

precisely.oewn-00159432-r.label: neutral
precisely.oewn-00159432-r.tone: The adverb of *precise*: the family's flat baseline: states that something is exact or sharply bounded, passing no verdict on whether the exactness is welcome.

preferably.oewn-00116461-r.label: positive
preferably.oewn-00116461-r.tone: The adverb of *preferable*: a comparative and nothing more — it rates one thing above another without claiming either is wanted much at all.

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

preferentially.oewn-00185898-r.label: neutral
preferentially.oewn-00185898-r.tone: The adverb of *preferential*: flat and administrative: it records that partiality is in play and leaves untouched the question *discriminatory* settles against it.

prettily.oewn-00433289-r.label: positive
prettily.oewn-00433289-r.tone: The adverb of *pretty*: pleasing but slight - delicate rather than striking, and faintly diminishing.

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

problematically.oewn-00434111-r.label: negative
problematically.oewn-00434111-r.tone: The adverb of *problematical*: stiffer and more formal than *problematic* for the same verdict, its extra syllable adding weight rather than force.

prosperously.oewn-00016322-r.label: positive
prosperously.oewn-00016322-r.tone: The adverb of *prosperous*: wealth read as the reward of success - approving.

proudly.oewn-00191358-r.label: neutral
proudly.oewn-00191358-r.tone: The adverb of *proud*: genuinely two-faced: proud of your children is warm, proud to a fault is a failing. Context decides.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

provably.oewn-00309952-r.label: neutral
provably.oewn-00309952-r.tone: The adverb of *provable*: the blunter twin of *demonstrable*, resting the whole claim on proof being possible.

family.axis: bare certainty of knowledge → esteem so vast it passes into legend

proverbially.oewn-00435802-r.label: neutral
proverbially.oewn-00435802-r.tone: The adverb of *proverbial*: familiarity by constant repetition, the thing quoted as a byword rather than admired as *famous* implies.

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

providentially.oewn-00436106-r.label: positive
providentially.oewn-00436106-r.tone: The adverb of *providential*: the graver word for that aptness, and it treats the rescue as intended rather than lucky.

pryingly.oewn-00436657-r.label: negative
pryingly.oewn-00436657-r.tone: The adverb of *prying*: names the act rather than the character - the person is doing it right now.

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

psychically.oewn-00208579-r.label: neutral
psychically.oewn-00208579-r.tone: The adverb of *psychical*: the heavier, more formal twin of *psychic*, identical in what it covers and stiffer in the saying.

family.axis: bare exactness → exactness pushed past its use

punctiliously.oewn-00437235-r.label: neutral
punctiliously.oewn-00437235-r.tone: The adverb of *punctilious*: formal and stiff, treating exact detail as an observance to be complied with, where *meticulous* treats it as care.

pusillanimously.oewn-00457002-r.label: negative
pusillanimously.oewn-00457002-r.tone: The adverb of *pusillanimous*: bookish contempt - small-spirited in the face of difficulty.

questioningly.oewn-00359488-r.label: neutral
questioningly.oewn-00359488-r.tone: The adverb of *questioning*: the plainest form: the questions are being asked, and nothing is implied about why.

rapaciously.oewn-00441286-r.label: negative
rapaciously.oewn-00441286-r.tone: The adverb of *rapacious*: the hunger is predatory - devouring as though by seizure.

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

rationally.oewn-00186016-r.label: positive
rationally.oewn-00186016-r.tone: The adverb of *rational*: approves by pointing at the grounds - the thing rests on reason - where *reasonable* praises the quality of the judgment actually reached.

ravishingly.oewn-00441443-r.label: positive
ravishingly.oewn-00441443-r.tone: The adverb of *ravishing*: overwhelming beauty - lush and a little theatrical.

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

reasonably.oewn-00217109-r.label: positive
reasonably.oewn-00217109-r.tone: The adverb of *reasonable*: solid approval of judgment exercised well, going past *rational*'s weaker claim that reason was involved at all.

recklessly.oewn-00356657-r.label: negative
recklessly.oewn-00356657-r.tone: The adverb of *reckless*: the gravest here - the unconcern is careless enough to imply danger.

reliably.oewn-00225012-r.label: positive
reliably.oewn-00225012-r.tone: The adverb of *reliable*: the plain word - trust earned by behaving the same way every time.

remorselessly.oewn-00402381-r.label: negative
remorselessly.oewn-00402381-r.tone: The adverb of *remorseless*: adds the aftermath: there was no regret once it was done.

richly.oewn-00189129-r.label: positive
richly.oewn-00189129-r.tone: The adverb of *rich*: the plain word - direct, and sometimes faintly accusing depending on who says it.

rottenly.oewn-00055639-r.label: negative
rottenly.oewn-00055639-r.tone: The adverb of *rotten*: thoroughly bad, with a hint of moral distaste.

ruthlessly.oewn-00447656-r.label: negative
ruthlessly.oewn-00447656-r.tone: The adverb of *ruthless*: the everyday word - it makes the absence of pity a settled character, not a lapse.

safely.oewn-00155346-r.label: positive
safely.oewn-00155346-r.tone: The adverb of *safe*: concerned with what cannot be lost rather than with what might be gained.

sagaciously.oewn-00274018-r.label: positive
sagaciously.oewn-00274018-r.tone: The adverb of *sagacious*: formal and warm - wisdom shown as insight rather than learning.

sagely.oewn-00202999-r.label: positive
sagely.oewn-00202999-r.tone: The adverb of *sage*: wisdom that came with age, and the noun stands just behind the adjective.

sapiently.oewn-00274018-r.label: positive
sapiently.oewn-00274018-r.tone: The adverb of *sapient*: Latinate and cool - wisdom observed from a distance rather than warmly praised.

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

satisfactorily.oewn-00015830-r.label: positive
satisfactorily.oewn-00015830-r.tone: The adverb of *satisfactory*: approval delivered as a finding rather than a compliment — it certifies that satisfaction was given, where *fine* simply grants it.

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

satisfyingly.oewn-00184950-r.label: positive
satisfyingly.oewn-00184950-r.tone: The adverb of *satisfying*: relief supplied by sufficiency itself — the worry lifts because the thing proves enough, where *comforting* works on the person instead.

sceptically.oewn-00448486-r.label: neutral
sceptically.oewn-00448486-r.tone: The adverb of *sceptical*: the British spelling, identical in force.

screakily.oewn-00304748-r.label: negative
screakily.oewn-00304748-r.tone: The adverb of *screaky*: the shriller variant, and it sounds like what it means.

family.axis: plain attentiveness → exhaustive minute care that tips into excess

scrupulously.oewn-00180072-r.label: positive
scrupulously.oewn-00180072-r.tone: The adverb of *scrupulous*: adds a moral edge to the same effort - exactness that would balk at the smallest lapse.

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

self-evidently.oewn-00450666-r.label: neutral
self-evidently.oewn-00450666-r.tone: The adverb of *self-evident*: the plainer word for the same standing as *axiomatic*: the thing carries its own warrant and asks for none to be brought.

selfishly.oewn-00328482-r.label: negative
selfishly.oewn-00328482-r.tone: The adverb of *selfish*: the plain moral word - a direct accusation, nothing clinical in it.

family.axis: bare defensibility → judgment praised as solid, steady and clear-minded

sensibly.oewn-00217109-r.label: positive
sensibly.oewn-00217109-r.tone: The adverb of *sensible*: warmer and more practical than *reasonable*, approving judgment for its plain usefulness rather than its defensibility.

family.axis: weighty enough to demand attention → threatening great harm with hope nearly gone

seriously.oewn-00016415-r.label: negative
seriously.oewn-00016415-r.tone: The adverb of *serious*: the flattest word here, insisting the threatened harm is real without dramatizing it the way *severe* dramatizes its force.

shoddily.oewn-00454631-r.label: negative
shoddily.oewn-00454631-r.tone: The adverb of *shoddy*: poor work passed off as sound - the pretence is as much of the charge as the quality.

sincerely.oewn-00380195-r.label: positive
sincerely.oewn-00380195-r.tone: The adverb of *sincere*: the plain claim that there is no gap between what is felt and what is said.

skeptically.oewn-00448486-r.label: neutral
skeptically.oewn-00448486-r.tone: The adverb of *skeptical*: a vice socially and a virtue scientifically; the field decides the charge.

slenderly.oewn-00460568-r.label: positive
slenderly.oewn-00460568-r.tone: The adverb of *slender*: admiring - thinness with grace built into the word.

slickly.oewn-00240144-r.label: negative
slickly.oewn-00240144-r.tone: The adverb of *slick*: the deception is in the smoothness - nothing catches, which is what makes it suspect.

slimly.oewn-00460568-r.label: positive
slimly.oewn-00460568-r.tone: The adverb of *slim*: the polite compliment - thin in a way people want to be.

slyly.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
slyly.oewn-00295240-r.tone: The adverb of *sly*: the everyday word, and the one that emphasises secrecy over skill.

smilingly.oewn-00461334-r.label: positive
smilingly.oewn-00461334-r.tone: The adverb of *smiling*: describes the evidence rather than the mood, which is why it can be worn falsely.

smugly.oewn-00461643-r.label: negative
smugly.oewn-00461643-r.tone: The adverb of *smug*: the social version: pleasure in being right, worn where others can see it.

speculatively.oewn-00243330-r.label: neutral
speculatively.oewn-00243330-r.tone: The adverb of *speculative*: curiosity held at a distance - it wonders and weighs rather than asks.

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

sportingly.oewn-00466176-r.label: positive
sportingly.oewn-00466176-r.tone: The adverb of *sporting*: warmer and easier than *clean*, crediting fair play as a spirit brought to the contest rather than a rule left unbroken.

family.axis: flat naming of dullness → slangy contempt for rigid, predictable sameness

stereotypically.oewn-00468284-r.label: negative
stereotypically.oewn-00468284-r.tone: The adverb of *stereotypical*: everyday and derisive, the predictability sharp enough that the thing is seen coming.

sternly.oewn-00242552-r.label: negative
sternly.oewn-00242552-r.tone: The adverb of *stern*: the face more than the rule; sternness is something the other person can see.

stingily.oewn-00468873-r.label: negative
stingily.oewn-00468873-r.tone: The adverb of *stingy*: the plain word. Its mirror image is *thrifty*, which praises the identical behaviour.

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

stringently.oewn-00471219-r.label: neutral
stringently.oewn-00471219-r.tone: The adverb of *stringent*: cool and administrative, stating how tightly the rules bind without either praising or resenting the binding.

stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.label: negative
stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.tone: The adverb of *stubborn*: refusal held past the point of reason - the word faults the persistence.

stupidly.oewn-00176830-r.label: negative
stupidly.oewn-00176830-r.tone: The adverb of *stupid*: the blunt, wounding word - a flat verdict on someone's mind.

suspiciously.oewn-00242731-r.label: negative
suspiciously.oewn-00242731-r.tone: The adverb of *suspicious*: distrust worn openly - it faults the withholding of trust, not the caution behind it.

terribly.oewn-00055639-r.label: negative
terribly.oewn-00055639-r.tone: The adverb of *terrible*: blunt and total - among the strongest everyday condemnations.

thankfully.oewn-00201311-r.label: positive
thankfully.oewn-00201311-r.tone: The adverb of *thankful*: carries a trace of prayer - thanks owed to providence as much as to a person.

trickily.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
trickily.oewn-00295240-r.tone: The adverb of *tricky*: a warning - the skill is in deceiving you.

uncivilly.oewn-00339742-r.label: negative
uncivilly.oewn-00339742-r.tone: The adverb of *uncivil*: formal and slightly distant - the complaint of someone invoking a standard.

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

uncomfortably.oewn-00156320-r.label: neutral
uncomfortably.oewn-00156320-r.tone: The adverb of *uncomfortable*: the plain cover term, working equally for the thing that gives the discomfort and the body that feels it, which is what keeps it so flat.

uncouthly.oewn-00487818-r.label: negative
uncouthly.oewn-00487818-r.tone: The adverb of *uncouth*: harsher than 'rough-cut': the missing refinement read as offensive in itself.

unfeignedly.oewn-00380195-r.label: positive
unfeignedly.oewn-00380195-r.tone: The adverb of *unfeigned*: defined against pretence, which is a curious way to have to say it.

unmercifully.oewn-00402381-r.label: negative
unmercifully.oewn-00402381-r.tone: The adverb of *unmerciful*: mercy named only as the thing withheld - slightly more formal than 'merciless'.

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

unqualifiedly.oewn-00231579-r.label: neutral
unqualifiedly.oewn-00231579-r.tone: The adverb of *unqualified*: the bare statement of the case — nothing limits or restricts the thing — with none of the insistence *categorical* puts behind it.

untidily.oewn-00402908-r.label: negative
untidily.oewn-00402908-r.tone: The adverb of *untidy*: the plain word, and a small complaint - it expects the state to be temporary.

valiantly.oewn-00494093-r.label: positive
valiantly.oewn-00494093-r.tone: The adverb of *valiant*: heroic register, at home in battle and legend.

family.axis: bare exactness → exactness pushed past its use

verily.oewn-00494943-r.label: neutral
verily.oewn-00494943-r.tone: The adverb of *very*: a bare intensifier of identity, insisting the thing is exactly the one stated and carrying no praise or blame with it.

viciously.oewn-00202624-r.label: negative
viciously.oewn-00202624-r.tone: The adverb of *vicious*: adds enjoyment to the harm - a vicious act is one the doer wanted to do.

vociferously.oewn-00155235-r.label: negative
vociferously.oewn-00155235-r.tone: The adverb of *vociferous*: loud to the point of offence - the outcry is itself the objection.

wealthily.oewn-00496653-r.label: positive
wealthily.oewn-00496653-r.tone: The adverb of *wealthy*: substantial and settled money - more dignified than 'rich'.

wholeheartedly.oewn-00497146-r.label: positive
wholeheartedly.oewn-00497146-r.tone: The adverb of *wholehearted*: devotion offered entire - nothing held back.

wisely.oewn-00202999-r.label: positive
wisely.oewn-00202999-r.tone: The adverb of *wise*: the plain word, and the one that has to be earned rather than displayed.

wonderingly.oewn-00359488-r.label: positive
wonderingly.oewn-00359488-r.tone: The adverb of *wondering*: curiosity with the wonder still in it, and no agenda attached.
